name: Chrome extension for auto-saving and snoozing tabs

mentions.name: Chrome extension for auto-saving and snoozing tabs
mentions.description: Chrome extension that automatically saves and closes tabs that haven't been used in a while, supports Gmail-style snoozing of tabs, stores everything locally with a privacy-first design, and provides native vim-like navigation.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've just finished this chrome extension recently: https://ypuf.com/

It helps me to automatically save a tab that's not been used in a while so it auto-closes it but saves it as well as having the ability to snooze a tab like how you'd do it in gmail.

Everything is locally stored with 100% privacy in mind.

And vim like navigation is natively done.
